run_export_hf_to_json: run the script to download the GAIA2 CLI dataset from HuggingFace and export scenarios as JSON files
run_export_with_custom_splits: run the export script with specific splits like search and execution using the --splits flag
run_export_with_force: run the export script with --force to overwrite existing JSON files in the destination directory
run_export_with_custom_dest: run the export script with a custom destination directory using the --dest argument
run_export_with_token: run the export script with a HuggingFace token using the --token argument for private datasets
